description: Solo opt-in fixture: NO campaignBound event, but creationLockConfig{auto:true} explicitly arms the automatic lock. Spend of 55 crosses DATA.level1AP. Asserts a purely local character CAN auto-lock when its owner opts in — 'Halfling: Brave' prices at the locked tier-2 rate (4). Direct contrast with EV-008, which is the identical scenario WITHOUT the opt-in and correctly stays unlocked (2). Together the pair pins both halves of the D-GH32 gate: solo never auto-locks by accident, but may by request.

events.label: Player opted in to automatic creation lock
Species trait — Halfling: Brave (locked by solo opt-in)
